steps.en: Cumulus sends receipt details to OCMS
steps.id: Cumulus mengirim detail receipt ke OCMS
steps.why_en: No code receives receipt details from Cumulus.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang menerima detail receipt dari Cumulus.

steps.en: OCMS receives and processes Cumulus receipt details
steps.id: OCMS menerima dan memproses detail receipt dari Cumulus
steps.why_en: No code reads or processes anything from Cumulus.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membaca atau memproses data dari Cumulus.

steps.en: Receipt details are updated in OCMS
steps.why_en: OCMS only stores a receipt number it generates itself, not one from Cumulus.
steps.why_id: OCMS hanya menyimpan nomor receipt buatannya sendiri, bukan dari Cumulus.
